items.finding: The definition of Confidential Information is entirely one-way, protecting only information disclosed by or on behalf of the Company (FinServe) to the Recipient (AtliQ).
items.quote: "Confidential Information" means all information, in any form, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Company to the Recipient or its Representatives, whether before or after the Effective Date, including customer and portfolio data, credit models, product plans, pricing, technology architecture, business processes, and all analyses, compilations, notes or other documents prepared by the Recipient that contain or reflect such information.
items.counterPosition: Amend the definition to make it fully mutual, protecting information disclosed by either Party.

items.finding: The obligations of use, non-disclosure, and security standards apply solely to the Recipient (AtliQ) protecting the Company's (FinServe) information.
items.counterPosition: Amend the obligations to apply mutually to both Parties as receiving parties.

items.finding: The residuals clause is one-way, giving only the Company the right to use residual information.
items.quote: Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement, the Company shall be free to use Residuals for any purpose, including the development, marketing and procurement of products and services, provided that this Clause 4.1 does not grant any licence under any patent or copyright.
items.counterPosition: Make the residuals clause mutual or delete it entirely.

items.finding: The indemnity for all losses and expenses is completely one-way, burdening only the Recipient, with no cap on liability.
items.quote: The Recipient shall indemnify the Company for all losses, costs and expenses (including legal fees) arising from any breach of this Agreement by the Recipient or its Representatives.
items.counterPosition: Delete the indemnity clause entirely, or make it mutual and subject to a reasonable liability cap.

items.finding: The agreement contains restrictive covenants, including a non-compete prohibiting AtliQ from providing similar services to any competitor, and a non-solicitation clause for staff, both of which apply solely to the Recipient.
items.quote:
8.1 In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

8.2 The Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its termination, directly or indirectly solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.
items.counterPosition: Remove the non-compete covenant entirely, and make the non-solicitation of employees mutual, with standard exceptions for general public recruitment advertisements.

items.finding: The confidentiality obligations survive termination in perpetuity, rather than for a fixed duration, and this survival obligation is one-way.
items.quote: The obligations of the Recipient under this Agreement shall survive termination and shall continue in perpetuity.
items.counterPosition: Amend the survival of confidentiality obligations to a reasonable fixed period (e.g., 3 to 5 years after termination) and make it mutual.
